action_items: No code changes required — both new features work as specified on backend and frontend.

Optional (nice-to-have): add explicit testIDs to the three stat boxes (e.g. stat-articles, stat-minutes, stat-streak) and to the '📊 Il tuo percorso' Card for stronger automated coverage; currently we validate via label text which is reliable but string-coupled.
Optional: consider adding a data-testid on the streak-3 badge chip once earned (badge-<key>) — right now presence is verified only via server-side stats.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:761-811 /me/stats correctly de-duplicates content_ids for articles_read (set of view.content_id) and unions views+completions for meditations; minutes computed via integer division of duration_sec — clean.

server.py:727-758 _compute_streak has a nice fallback: if today has no activity, walk back from yesterday. Correctly returns (0,0) on empty input. Longest-streak scan is O(n log n) — acceptable for view counts.

server.py:817-830 GET /admin/comments enriches each comment with content_title by looking up the right collection based on content_type; falls back to '(cancellato)' if the target was deleted — good UX.
server.py:833-838 DELETE /admin/comments/{id} correctly returns 404 when nothing was deleted — proper HTTP semantics.
profile.tsx:105-137 The stats Card is only rendered when `stats` is truthy — prevents 'NaN' flash while loading; badges list uses key={b.key}; empty state shows the italian hint. Good pattern.
admin.tsx:625-664 CommentsSection uses react-query invalidateQueries after delete — cache stays consistent. Uses ScrollView with insets.bottom padding for safe area. Good.
No deprecated Expo packages spotted in the new files (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch).
